payload.register:
R1 ABSOLUTE ACTION URL (functional). WHEN publishing a card, SE SHALL build every action URL as an absolute http(s) URL from the configured base and the answer topic. verify_method: test. breaks_if_removed: the tap fails with 'Expected URL scheme http or https' - owner-witnessed 2026-07-25. source_refs: UC-A step 6, S1, v1 ask.go ntfyHeaders.

R2 A GATE LOOKS LIKE A GATE (functional). WHEN the announced offer is a gate, SE SHALL title the card with the iteration and gate, raise its priority, and tag it distinctly from an ordinary question. verify_method: test. breaks_if_removed: a gate is indistinguishable from noise on a lock screen - v1 ruled the distinction deliberately. source_refs: v1 ask.go, S1.

R3 ACTION BUDGET (functional). SE SHALL publish at most three actions, and WHERE a brief exists SHALL reserve the third for opening it. verify_method: test. breaks_if_removed: ntfy silently drops actions past three, so the brief's link would vanish without a symptom. source_refs: v1 ask.go limit logic.

R4 THE BRIEF RENDERS THE DECISION (functional). WHEN announcing a human-adjudicated gate, SE SHALL render one self-contained page carrying the gate's brief and its evidence fields. verify_method: test. breaks_if_removed: the owner decides on a truncated sentence, which is rubber-stamping. source_refs: UC-A step 3, S2, v1 adr-handoff-html.

R5 THE HOST HOLDS CIPHERTEXT (functional). SE SHALL encrypt the page before publishing and SHALL place the key only in the URL fragment. verify_method: test - the stored object contains none of the brief's words. breaks_if_removed: ledger content sits in plaintext on a third-party host. source_refs: UC-C, S3, se-v2-design §11/§18.

R6 NEVER ANNOUNCE AN UNSERVABLE PAGE (functional). SE SHALL confirm the published page serves BEFORE announcing its link. verify_method: test. breaks_if_removed: the owner taps into a 404 - the store is ~60s eventually consistent, the lesson the design recorded from its own dry run. source_refs: UC-A step 5, §18.

R7 A BRIEF DOES NOT OUTLIVE ITS DECISION (functional). SE SHALL publish with an expiry no longer than the offer's remaining life. verify_method: test. breaks_if_removed: briefs accumulate as a readable archive at a third party - the pressure test's folded finding. source_refs: UC-D, S6.

R8 DEGRADE, DO NOT BLOCK (functional, unwanted-behaviour). IF the brief cannot be published or verified, THEN SE SHALL still publish the card with its bless and dismiss actions. verify_method: test. breaks_if_removed: a host outage becomes a gate outage. source_refs: UC-A ext 4a/5a, S4.

R9 MODE BY ADJUDICATOR (functional). SE SHALL announce only when a human will adjudicate the gate, and SHALL publish nothing for one the agent will self-bless. verify_method: test. breaks_if_removed: either the owner is spammed during unattended runs, or - the failure that happened - a gate they must decide reaches nobody. source_refs: owner ruling 2026-07-25, S5.

R10 CONFIG READ WHEN NEEDED (functional). SE SHALL read the pairing configuration at announce time, not only at process start. verify_method: test. breaks_if_removed: restoring or changing the pairing does nothing until the board is cycled, with no surface saying so - witnessed today. source_refs: UC-A step 2, note-3f1437f22172.

R11 THE TOKEN STAYS PUT (constraint). SE SHALL NOT place the store's token in any log, brief, grant or run record. verify_method: test plus inspection. breaks_if_removed: a credential leaks into the committed record. binding norm: the same discipline i8 kept for the ntfy token.

R12 AN ANNOUNCEMENT IS RECORDED (functional). SE SHALL record every announcement's outcome, success or failure, where the agent and the owner can see it. verify_method: test. breaks_if_removed: a broken lane is indistinguishable from a quiet one - the reason today's defect survived a day. source_refs: UC-A step 7, S4.

Q1 REACHABILITY (quality: reliability). SOURCE: an agent parking on a human-adjudicated gate. STIMULUS: any part of the announcement fails. ARTIFACT: the announce path. ENVIRONMENT: unattended operation. RESPONSE: the owner receives something actionable, or the failure is recorded as unreachable. MEASURE: after any induced failure, either a card exists or a recorded failure does - never neither. verify_method: test. breaks_if_removed: the agent parks believing the owner was reached.

D1 THE TAP (demonstration). The loop SHALL be demonstrated end to end on a real device: card received, brief opened, tap returning a grant with channel=phone. verify_method: demonstration - this iteration's own release gate. breaks_if_removed: the leg the design flagged as unverified ships unverified again, which is why this iteration exists.
payload.set_criteria: COMPLETE against the use cases: every main-scenario step of UC-A, UC-B, UC-C and UC-D maps to at least one requirement, and every numbered extension maps to R8, R9 or the unchanged stale/duplicate rules. CONSISTENT: the failure philosophy is uniform - degrade and record (R8, R12, Q1) rather than block, with the single exception that an unservable page is never announced (R6), which serves the same goal of not misleading. AFFORDABLE: one engine module for the transport plus changes to the existing lane; the store's account, worker and namespace already exist and were re-verified before scoping. BOUNDED: nothing here edits decisions from the phone, renders the cone, adds a channel, or automates the account. NO TBD. HONEST LIMIT NAMED: R5 protects against the HOST, not against whoever holds the topic - the link and its key travel through a relay that retains for about twelve hours, and that is the accepted-risk model the owner already ruled, now stated for brief content as well as taps.
